# sustain_private_location (Resource)

One of the workspace's own agents, run inside its own network, which checks its monitors there for it alone. Its key is answered once, when it's made, and kept, sensitive.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An agent inside the office's network: its key, sensitive, is what the agent is started with.
resource "sustain_private_location" "office" {
  name = "Office"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO 8601 time in UTC.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) `sw_location_<region>_`, the workspace's id as hex, `_` and 48 hex digits: its agent's `SUSTAIN_LOCATION_KEY`.
- `key_made_at` (String) When its key was made: its agent asks with no other.
- `key_prefix` (String) Enough of its key to tell it from another.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By its id in Sustain, as its page in the console, or its API, gives it.
terraform import sustain_private_location.office <id>
```
